corpus_fingerprint.note: sampling is deterministic against a frozen corpus; the store is live, so two runs with different fingerprints are different samples, not a repeat.

method.design: paired, per-check via verify.run_check (NOT the kill-fast lane)
method.liveness_fence: every treatment cell must be stamped entity_template or the run aborts (§18.3 inert-arm trap)
method.retrieval_failures: excluded from both numerator and denominator
method.outage_fence: two whole candidates unruled aborts the arm (arm B is then not billed); any check/arm cell with a zero denominator aborts the run. An outage is the end of the measurement, not a datum.
